scope: 450 same-state pairs (900 trials). Only the compared support slot differs; all saves pass the production validator.
policy: Unmodified one-turn bounded beam heuristic. Known synthetic draw pile. Turn 3 carries a synthetic previous-zero-mana flag; other turns do not.
limits: Comparator costs/effects differ intentionally. Outcomes cover one turn and its enemy response; reservations are reported separately, not converted into actual future damage. Not natural acquisition, optimal play, full-run card strength, or human enjoyment.
